# Canadian Citizenship Quiz

> Free practice for the Canadian citizenship test (20 questions, 45 minutes, 15 correct answers to pass, as published by IRCC), with every answer explained, in English and in Canadian French, plus a day-by-day count of the 1,095 days of physical presence, IRCC fees and each step from the application to the oath. Independent site published by Radif Partners, not IRCC. Questions written from the facts of Discover Canada; rules and fees read on canada.ca and dated in one parameter file.

## Pages in English

- [Canadian Citizenship Test 2026: Free Practice Exam, 20 Qs](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/): Free Canadian citizenship test practice for 2026: 20 questions in 45 minutes, pass at 15 correct answers like IRCC's test, every answer explained, no sign-up.
- [Question writers: who runs the Canadian Citizenship Quiz](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/about/): Who publishes Canadian Citizenship Quiz, how its English and French questions are written, where each IRCC rule and fee comes from, and what it never sells.
- [Apply for Canadian citizenship: eligibility checklist 2026](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/apply-for-canadian-citizenship/): Before you apply for Canadian citizenship: 1,095 days in 5 years, 730 as a PR, 3 tax years, CLB 4 at ages 18 to 54, and the prohibitions that block a file.
- [Citizenship application: documents, photos and signing date](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-application/): Canadian citizenship application in 2026: online or paper, form CIT 0002, the document checklist, 50 x 70 mm photos, police certificates and the date you sign.
- [Canadian citizenship ceremony and oath: what to bring](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-ceremony/): The Canadian citizenship ceremony: the invitation, virtual or in person, documents to bring, the oath from age 14, rescheduling and a missed ceremony.
- [Canadian citizenship certificate: $75 proof, forms, search](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-certificate/): The Canadian citizenship certificate: what it proves, who needs one, the $75 fee, online or paper application, urgent processing and the separate record search.
- [Citizenship interview and hearing: what IRCC checks](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-interview/): After the citizenship test, IRCC may hold an interview; after three failures, a 30 to 90 minute hearing. What is checked, what to bring and how it is scored.
- [History quiz for the Canadian citizenship test: key dates](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/canadian-history/): Practise the history chapter of Discover Canada: 1497, 1608, 1759, 1791, 1867, 1885, Vimy and Juno Beach, with a timeline and answers corrected as you go.
- [Symbols quiz: flag, anthem, motto and honours of the test](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/canadian-symbols/): Practise the Canadian Symbols chapter of Discover Canada: the 1965 flag, O Canada, the motto, the beaver, sports and honours, with answers corrected at once.
- [Economy quiz: trade, industries and resources for the test](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/economy/): Revise the economy chapter of Discover Canada: service, manufacturing and resource industries, free trade, which province produces what, with a corrected quiz.
- [Federal elections quiz: voting rules on the citizenship test](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/federal-elections/): Revise the Federal Elections chapter of Discover Canada: who can vote, ridings, secret ballot, majority and minority governments, with a corrected quiz.
- [Government quiz: how Canadians govern themselves, chapter 5](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/government/): Practise the government chapter of Discover Canada: Parliament, the Sovereign, Senate, federal and provincial powers, royal assent, with a corrected quiz.
- [Justice system quiz: courts, police and due process](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/justice-system/): Revise The Justice System chapter of Discover Canada: presumption of innocence, due process, the courts, the RCMP and legal aid, with a corrected practice quiz.
- [Modern Canada quiz: postwar years, inventors and artists](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/modern-canada/): Revise the Modern Canada chapter of Discover Canada: NATO, Korea, the Quiet Revolution, the 1969 language law, Terry Fox and insulin, with a corrected quiz.
- [Online citizenship test: device rules, ID and missed tests](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/online/): Check your device before the online citizenship test: webcam, Chrome or Safari, no phone or VPN, accepted ID, the 30-day window and what happens if you miss it.
- [Citizenship test pass mark: 15 of 20, 3 attempts, hearing](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/pass-mark/): The Canadian citizenship test pass mark is 15 correct answers out of 20. Check your score, see how many attempts you have left and what the hearing involves.
- [Citizenship test practice: 10 questions corrected at once](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/practice/): Free practice for the Canadian citizenship test: sets of 10 questions from every chapter of Discover Canada, each answer corrected and explained right away.
- [Citizenship test questions and answers, chapter by chapter](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/questions-and-answers/): All our Canadian citizenship test questions with answers and explanations, sorted by the ten chapters of Discover Canada. Pick a chapter and test yourself.
- [Regions quiz: provinces, territories and their capitals](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/regions/): Practise the regions chapter of Discover Canada: five regions, provincial and territorial capitals, Nunavut, the Bay of Fundy, Mount Logan, with a quiz.
- [Rights and responsibilities quiz: citizenship test chapter 1](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/rights-and-responsibilities/): Practise the Rights and Responsibilities chapter of Discover Canada: the 1982 Charter, fundamental freedoms, jury duty and voting, with corrected answers.
- [Who We Are quiz: Aboriginal peoples, Acadians, Québécois](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship-test/who-we-are/): Revise the Who We Are chapter of Discover Canada: First Nations, Inuit, Métis, the founding peoples, Acadians and official languages, with a corrected quiz.
- [Canadian citizenship: routes, conditions and steps in 2026](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship/): Canadian citizenship in 2026: the grant for permanent residents, minors, proof by descent, resumption and renunciation, with fees, forms and the steps in order.
- [Citizenship test age exemption: 55 and over, minors, waivers](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship/age-exemptions/): Age exemptions for Canadian citizenship: no test and no language proof at 55 or over or under 18, measured on the day you sign, plus waivers on request.
- [Canadian citizenship by descent: Bill C-3 rules since 2025](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship/by-descent/): Citizenship by descent after Bill C-3: who is a citizen when born abroad to a Canadian, the 1,095-day rule for parents born abroad, and the certificate.
- [Citizenship days calculator: your 1,095th day, trip by trip](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship/days-calculator/): Find the first date you meet the 1,095 days of physical presence for Canadian citizenship: trips counted day by day, half credit before PR, window shown.
- [Citizenship fees 2026: $653 per adult, $100 per child](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship/fees/): Canadian citizenship fees in 2026: $653 per adult including the $123 right of citizenship fee, $100 per minor, plus certificate, resumption and other fees.
- [Citizenship language requirement: CLB 4 and accepted proof](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship/language-requirement/): Language requirement for Canadian citizenship: CLB 4 in speaking and listening at ages 18 to 54, proven by a diploma, a test such as CELPIP or TEF, or training.
- [Citizenship for minors: forms, $100 fee, oath from age 14](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship/minors/): Canadian citizenship for children under 18: the route with a Canadian or co-applying parent, the route alone, forms, the $100 fee and the oath from 14.
- [Permanent resident days for citizenship: 730 and the credit](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship/permanent-resident-days/): Permanent resident days for Canadian citizenship: at least 730 days as a PR within the 1,095, half credit for earlier stays up to 365 days, and the PR card.
- [Citizenship for the spouse of a Canadian: no shortcut, 2026](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship/spouse/): Married to a Canadian? Citizenship still takes 1,095 days in 5 years and the usual conditions. Who can apply first, filing together, and the single exception.
- [Tax filing for citizenship: 3 of 5 years if a return was due](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship/tax-filing/): Tax filing for Canadian citizenship: returns for 3 of the 5 years before you apply, only when the Income Tax Act required them. The form, and who is exempt.
- [Canadian citizenship timeline: each step to the oath](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/canadian-citizenship/timeline/): Canadian citizenship timeline from the day you sign: receipt, acknowledgement, test period, interview, ceremony and oath, with every date a rule fixes.
- [Discover Canada study guide: 10 chapters and a study plan](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/discover-canada-study-guide/): Discover Canada is the only official guide for the citizenship test. See its ten chapters, what each covers, and build a study plan from the days you have left.
- [Mock test method: questions, 15/20 marking, 1,095 days](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/method/): How Canadian Citizenship Quiz writes its questions from Discover Canada, marks a 20-question mock test, counts the 1,095 days and adds up the IRCC fees.
- [Renounce Canadian citizenship: conditions, $100 fee, forms](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/renounce-canadian-citizenship/): How renouncing Canadian citizenship works: another citizenship, no residence in Canada, age 18, a $100 fee, and the free route for automatic citizens.
- [Resume Canadian citizenship: 365 days in 2 years, $530 fee](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/en/resume-canadian-citizenship/): Resuming Canadian citizenship as a former citizen: permanent residence, 365 days in Canada in 2 years, one tax year, paper form CIT 0301, fees of $530 or $100.

- [Quiz citoyenneté canadienne : qui écrit les questions](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/a-propos/): Qui publie Quiz citoyenneté canadienne, comment ses questions sont rédigées en français, d’où viennent les règles et frais d’IRCC, ce qu’il ne vend pas.
- [Cérémonie de citoyenneté et serment : documents à apporter](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/ceremonie-citoyennete/): La cérémonie de citoyenneté canadienne : convocation, format virtuel ou en personne, documents, serment dès 14 ans, demande de report et cérémonie manquée.
- [Certificat de citoyenneté canadienne : la preuve pour 75 $](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/certificat-citoyennete/): Le certificat de citoyenneté canadienne : ce qu’il prouve, qui en a besoin, 75 $ de frais, demande en ligne ou papier, traitement urgent, recherche de dossier.
- [Citoyenneté canadienne : démarches, conditions et étapes](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/citoyennete-canadienne/): Citoyenneté canadienne en 2026 : attribution aux résidents permanents, enfants, preuve par filiation, réintégration et répudiation, frais, formulaires, étapes.
- [Jours de présence pour la citoyenneté : votre 1 095e jour](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/citoyennete-canadienne/calcul-des-jours/): Trouvez la première date où vous atteignez les 1 095 jours de présence pour la citoyenneté canadienne : voyages comptés au jour près, demi-crédit avant la RP.
- [Citoyenneté du conjoint d’un Canadien : aucun raccourci](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/citoyennete-canadienne/conjoint/): Marié à un Canadien ? La citoyenneté exige toujours 1 095 jours en 5 ans et les conditions habituelles. Qui dépose en premier, la demande à deux, l’exception.
- [Impôts et citoyenneté : 3 déclarations sur 5 si exigées](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/citoyennete-canadienne/declarations-impots/): Impôts et citoyenneté canadienne : déclarations pour 3 des 5 années avant la demande, si la loi les exigeait. Ce que demande le formulaire et qui est exempté.
- [Citoyenneté d’un enfant mineur : formulaires, 100 $, serment](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/citoyennete-canadienne/enfants-mineurs/): Citoyenneté canadienne d’un enfant de moins de 18 ans : la voie avec un parent canadien ou demandeur, la voie seule, frais de 100 $, serment dès 14 ans.
- [Étapes de la citoyenneté canadienne, du dépôt au serment](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/citoyennete-canadienne/etapes/): Les étapes de la citoyenneté canadienne à partir de la signature : réception, accusé de réception, examen, entrevue, cérémonie et serment, avec les dates fixes.
- [Exemption d’examen de citoyenneté : 55 ans et plus, mineurs](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/citoyennete-canadienne/exemptions-age/): Exemptions liées à l’âge pour la citoyenneté canadienne : ni examen ni preuve de langue à 55 ans ou plus et avant 18 ans, âge à la signature, dispenses.
- [Frais de citoyenneté 2026 : 653 $ l’adulte, 100 $ l’enfant](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/citoyennete-canadienne/frais/): Frais de citoyenneté canadienne en 2026 : 653 $ par adulte, dont 123 $ pour le droit de citoyenneté, 100 $ par mineur, plus les frais de certificat et autres.
- [Jours de résident permanent : 730 et le crédit avant la RP](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/citoyennete-canadienne/jours-resident-permanent/): Jours de résident permanent pour la citoyenneté canadienne : au moins 730 jours comme RP sur 1 095, demi-crédit du séjour antérieur jusqu’à 365 jours.
- [Citoyenneté canadienne par filiation : règles du projet C-3](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/citoyennete-canadienne/par-filiation/): Citoyenneté par filiation après le projet C-3 : qui est citoyen quand il est né à l’étranger d’un Canadien, la règle des 1 095 jours du parent, le certificat.
- [Preuve de langue pour la citoyenneté : NCLC 4 et documents](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/citoyennete-canadienne/preuve-de-langue/): Preuve de langue pour la citoyenneté canadienne : NCLC/CLB 4 à l’oral de 18 à 54 ans, par un diplôme, un test comme le TEF Canada ou CELPIP, ou des cours.
- [Demande de citoyenneté : pièces, photos et date de signature](https://canadiancitizenshipquiz.com/fr/demande-de-citoyennete/): Demande de citoyenneté canadienne en 2026 : en ligne ou papier, formulaire CIT 0002, pièces, photos de 50 x 70 mm, certificats de police et date de signature.
